o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قِزْ (qız), from Proto-Turkic *kï̄ŕ (“girl, woman”).
From tapda- + -ala. Possibly a derivation of Proto-Turkic *tep-, *dēp- (“to stamp, tramp”) and related to Azerbaijani təpik (“kick”). Probably ultimately of onomatopoetic origin.
